newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-ZOLA NAMED ENGLISH FOOTBALLER OF THE YEAR.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-ZOLA NAMED ENGLISH FOOTBALLER OF THE YEAR.

text.p: Chelsea's Italian striker Gianfranco Zola has been named England's Footballer of the Year -- the third successive overseas player to win the award.
Zola follows German Juergen Klinsmann and last year's winner Eric Cantona as recipient of the award, voted for by the Football Writers' Association.
Another foreign player, Middlesbrough's Brazilian midfielder, Juninho, took second spot.
Third was Chelsea's Welsh striker, Mark Hughes, meaning the top three could all figure in this season's F.A. Cup final between Chelsea and Middlesbrough on May 17.
Zola, however, is fighting to overcome a damaged hamstring and took no part in Chelsea's premier league game against Leeds on Saturday.
David Beckham of Manchester United was the top Englishman in fourth place.
